caption: The drawing displays a detailed illustration of an oval-shaped object with a handle, resembling a trivet, rendered in shades of black and grey on an off-white background. The object features an openwork design with a central circular hub from which six radiating spokes extend outward, creating a geometric, symmetrical pattern completed with additional connecting curved and straight elements. The handle is elongated, also open in design, with a loop at the end. Three distinct views are presented: a perspective view at the lower right showing the trivet in three dimensions, positioned at an angle to display both the face and thickness; a top view at the upper left, showing the whole design from above; and a side elevation near the center, illustrating the object's profile and thickness. A linear scale marked with inches sits below the top and side views for dimensional reference. The composition is drawn with fine lines and stippling to represent material texture and depth. The background is unadorned, with the signature "Holger Hanson" in the lower right corner.
title: Trivet
